result.summary: Implemented the gate-approved design exactly. GAP A: write_target_definition/4 -> /5 in lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex; the widened function now takes an audit_context map (review_id/source_tenant_id/target_tenant_id, already available to do_promote_definition/7) and, as a new step 8(c) INSIDE the same Repo.transaction/1 that deprecates the previous active row and activates the new one, calls Audit.insert_entry(Repo, attrs, target_prefix) with action "definition.promote", resource_type "definition", resource_id = new_row.id, before_state nil, after_state field-for-field identical to append_promotion_event/9's own DEFINITION_PROMOTED event_attrs, trace_id nil -- {:error, reason} -> Repo.rollback(reason), the same pattern activate_draft_row/4 in definitions.ex already uses. No public-function signature changed (promote_definition/3, promote_active_definition/5, apply_review/4 untouched); lib/letflow/audit.ex and lib/letflow/instances.ex were not modified, per the design's files-touched table. GAP B: new GET /promotions/platform-events route (R11) added to lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex, declared before get "/:id" so the literal path segment isn't captured by the :id wildcard; :Unknown-gated via the plain get macro (no policy key), matching every other route in that router (PLATFORM_ADMIN-only per Letflow.Api.Authorization.evaluate_access/2's catch-all). Backed by a new Letflow.EventStore.list_platform_events/1 (queries events where instance_id == platform_instance_id(), optional event_type filter, ordered asc: sequence_number, page_size+1/drop-extra-row cursor idiom, decoded payload returned as-is). Response is a hand-built allowlist map (event_id/event_type/actor_id/timestamp/sequence_num/payload) with a distinct "PE:" cursor-endpoint prefix (does not collide with "A:"/"T:"/"U:" already in use). Real command output: `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> clean compile, zero warnings, on all three edits (verified after each file and again at the end). `mix test test/letflow/definitions/promotion_test.exs test/letflow/audit_test.exs test/letflow/event_store_test.exs test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 78.6 seconds ... Result: 77 passed'. `mix test test/letflow/definitions_test.exs test/letflow/entities/definitions_test.exs test/letflow/routers/definitions_test.exs test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs` -> 'Finished in 81.9 seconds ... Result: 133 passed'. 210 tests total, 0 failures, 0 regressions across every acceptance-criterion-named suite plus lib/letflow/instances.ex's own router test (untouched code path, confirmed still green).
